description: Test support utilities and mocks for CLI agent testing in the openclaw project, including mock implementations, setup functions, and constants.

methods.name: createManagedRun
methods.description: Creates a mock managed run object with specified exit conditions and process ID.

methods.name: mockSuccessfulCliRun
methods.description: Mocks a successful CLI run with predefined exit status and output.

methods.name: setupCliRunnerTestModule
methods.description: Sets up the testing environment for CLI runner, including plugin registry and mocks.

methods.name: setupClaudeCliRunnerTestModule
methods.description: Sets up the testing environment specifically for Claude CLI runner.

methods.name: stubBootstrapContext
methods.description: Mocks the bootstrap context with specified bootstrap and context files.

methods.name: runCliAgentWithBackendConfig
methods.description: Runs the CLI agent with a specified backend configuration and session details.

methods.name: runExistingCodexCliAgent
methods.description: Runs an existing Codex CLI agent with session binding and profile IDs.

methods.name: withTempImageFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory and image file for testing purposes.
